text: The most common and recognisable Alaskan licence plate is **all yellow**. In Generation 4 coverage you can also get a plate with a large orange circle in the middle. Front plates are required in Alaska.
text_zh: 最常見且最容易辨識的阿拉斯加車牌是**全黃色**的。在第四代街景覆蓋中，你也會看到車牌中間有一個大橘色圓圈。阿拉斯加要求車輛懸掛前車牌。

text: The Alaskan highway shield has an image of the **Big Dipper constellation** on the bottom left.
text_zh: 阿拉斯加的公路盾牌標誌左下方有**北斗七星**的圖案。

text: Trees in Alaska are generally **thinner** and have less broad leaves than those seen in the other 49 states.
text_zh: 阿拉斯加的樹木通常比較**細**，葉子也比較不寬大，與美國其他 49 州的樹木相比。

text: On a lot of the Alaskan coverage you will be able to see tall, **snow covered mountains**.
text_zh: 在許多阿拉斯加的街景覆蓋中，你會看到高聳的**白雪覆蓋山脈**。

text: In most of the US, Generation 2 is rare. However, Alaska has a fair amount of **Generation 2 coverage**.
text_zh: 在美國大部分地區，第二代街景覆蓋很少見。然而，阿拉斯加有相當多的**第二代街景覆蓋**。

text: Alaska has Generation 4 “smallcam” coverage, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front, with the front of the white car being very visible. The blur can also be fully transparent.
text_zh: 阿拉斯加有第四代「小型攝影機」街景覆蓋，這種攝影機安裝位置比一般的第四代街景低，並帶有相對較大的圓形模糊，前方有一個小突起，白色 Google 車的前方非常明顯。模糊部分也可能完全透明。

text: Alaska is the only state in the US where **shitcam** **coverage **is prevalent. This coverage is lower resolution with more faded colours, compared to other camera generations. Also, a large blur can be seen at the bottom of the page.
text_zh: 阿拉斯加是美國唯一一個**爛畫質街景覆蓋**普遍存在的州。與其他相機世代相比，這種街景覆蓋解析度較低，顏色也較褪色。此外，頁面底部會看到一個大塊的模糊。

text: **Generation 4** coverage in Alaska is concentrated around the city of **Anchorage**.
text_zh: 阿拉斯加的**第四代**街景覆蓋主要集中在**安克拉治**市周圍。

text: Most of interior and northern Alaska lies in subarctic or** tundra** climate zones. These areas feature relatively low amounts of [forest undergrowth](https://maps.app.goo.gl/mFe2xNzxYnqgY5Af6) and [shorter trees](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oaa8n8a7AbYVj7YSA).
text_zh: 阿拉斯加內陸及北部大部分地區屬於副北極或**苔原**氣候區。這些地區的[森林下層植被](https://maps.app.goo.gl/mFe2xNzxYnqgY5Af6)相對稀疏，[樹木也較矮](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oaa8n8a7AbYVj7YSA)。

text: The Alaskan towns in the Alexander Archipelago, on the British Columbia border have a unique look. Tall mountains with **lush green forests** can be seen in the background, with the majority of buildings made of wood. In addition, [Generation 2](https://goo.gl/maps/YU3fykwkkhwSeihP8) coverage is often overcast and misty.
NOTE: Coastal areas of [Oregon](https://goo.gl/maps/JUuhjUojP42eQrsF7) and [Washington](https://goo.gl/maps/LikUSJBshaMjidcK6) can have a similar appearance in terms of landscape and foliage.
text_zh: 位於與英屬哥倫比亞省接壤處的亞歷山大群島阿拉斯加城鎮，外觀獨特。背景可見高聳且**綠意盎然的森林**山脈，大部分建築物為木造。此外，[第二代相機](https://goo.gl/maps/YU3fykwkkhwSeihP8)的街景覆蓋通常陰天且多霧。
注意：[奧勒岡州](https://goo.gl/maps/JUuhjUojP42eQrsF7)和[華盛頓州](https://goo.gl/maps/LikUSJBshaMjidcK6)的沿海地區在景觀和植被方面可能外觀相似。

text: The only two major **urban areas** in Alaska are Anchorage and [Fairbanks](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kGD8vrgWHiQVVy73A).
text_zh: 阿拉斯加僅有的兩個主要**都會區**是安克拉治和[費爾班克斯](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kGD8vrgWHiQVVy73A)。

text: Most of the **suburban areas** in Alaska are in and around Anchorage.These areas feature wide roads, commercial districts, and sometimes heavy traffic. Mountains can commonly be seen in the distance.
NOTE: Fairbanks has some [similar areas](https://maps.app.goo.gl/y5zA5uE8KjngyPVV8), but mountains are less prevalent.
text_zh: 阿拉斯加大部分的**郊區**位於安克拉治市區及周邊。這些地區的特色是道路寬敞、商業區林立，有時交通繁忙。遠處通常可見山脈。
注意：費爾班克斯也有一些[類似的區域](https://maps.app.goo.gl/y5zA5uE8KjngyPVV8)，但山脈較不常見。

text: **Aspen trees** ([Populus tremuloides](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Populus_tremuloides)) can be found in lower elevation areas of interior and south-central regions of Alaska. These trees have white bark and rounded leaves.
text_zh: 阿拉斯加內部及中南部較低海拔地區可以找到**白樺樹** ([山楊](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Populus_tremuloides))。這些樹有白色的樹皮和圓形的葉子。

text: Due to Alaska’s very cold climate; **agricultural fields** are mainly found in the south of the state, mostly in the Matanuska Valley and Kenai Peninsula.
text_zh: 由於阿拉斯加氣候非常寒冷，**農田**主要分佈在該州南部，大多位於馬塔努斯卡谷和基奈半島。

text: The **Alaskan pipeline** which is usually visible from main roads, can be seen at these points. This is an easy way to identify Alaska as there are no similar pipelines in the rest of the US.
text_zh: 通常從主要道路可見的**阿拉斯加輸油管**，在這些地點可以看到。這是辨識阿拉斯加的簡單方法，因為美國其他地區沒有類似的輸油管。

text: **Juneau**, Alaska’s Capital city, is the largest settlement in the Alaskan panhandle. Therefore, it is much more ‘built up’ than other towns in this area. The city is surrounded by heavily forested mountains and hills.
text_zh: **朱諾**是阿拉斯加州的首府，也是阿拉斯加狹長地帶最大的聚落。因此，相較於該地區其他城鎮，朱諾的「建設」更為完善。這座城市被森林密布的山脈和丘陵環繞。

text: Fire hydrants in Anchorage are typically** pale pink **or** pale yellow** in colour.
text_zh: 安克拉治的消防栓通常是**淡粉色**或**淡黃色**。

text: Fire hydrants in Fairbanks are commonly either** bright yellow **or a** combination of colours** (most commonly [yellow and blue](https://maps.app.goo.gl/akUtjiVdnQMo9emy6)).
text_zh: 費爾班克斯的消防栓通常是**亮黃色**或**多種顏色組合**（最常見的是[黃色和藍色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/akUtjiVdnQMo9emy6)）。

text: **Shitcam** is only found around Anchorage and Fairbanks, and parts of the road that connects them.
NOTE: This map shows all places where this camera can be found. Keep in mind coverage may be updated in some places, therefore you may come across regular coverage in places highlighted here.
text_zh: **爛畫質相機**僅見於安克拉治和費爾班克斯周邊，以及連接兩地的部分路段。
注意：這張地圖顯示了所有可以找到這種相機的地方。請記住，某些地方的街景覆蓋可能會更新，因此你可能會在這些標示出來的地方遇到一般的街景覆蓋。

text: The North end of the Dalton Highway features a **flat** and **snowy landscape** and an overcast sky. A [small ridge](https://goo.gl/maps/fNWJxvvpz1Jzwjs89) of hills can be seen to the west of the highway in certain spots.
text_zh: 道爾頓公路的北端特徵是**平坦**的**雪景**和陰沉的天空。在某些地點，可以在公路西側看到[一條小山脊](https://goo.gl/maps/fNWJxvvpz1Jzwjs89)。

text: The Denali highway, stretching from Cantwell to Paxson in central Alaska, is a mostly **gravel highway** in the ‘Alaska’ mountain range. This road runs generally east to west, is covered in the generation 2 camera, and was taken in late summer, so wildflowers and green shrubby plants are common.
text_zh: 迪納利公路從阿拉斯加中部的坎特威爾延伸到帕克斯頓，是「阿拉斯加」山脈中一條大多為**碎石公路**。這條道路大致呈東西走向，由第二代相機拍攝，且是在夏末拍攝的，因此野花和綠色灌木植物很常見。

text: The Steese Highway is another gravel highway that goes from Fairbanks to the town of ‘Central.’ Similar to the Denali highway, this road runs generally east to west and is covered in generation 2. The difference, however, is that the **mountains** along this road are noticeably **lower** than the ones adjacent to the Denali Highway.
text_zh: 史蒂斯公路是另一條碎石公路，從費爾班克斯通往「中央」鎮。與迪納利公路類似，這條道路大致呈東西走向，並由第二代相機拍攝。然而，不同之處在於，沿著這條路的**山脈**明顯**較低**，比迪納利公路旁邊的山脈矮。

text: Highway 5, from the Yukon border to Tetlin Junction, can be recognized by the **foggy, rainy** weather, and Generation 2 camera.

NOTE: The Top of the World Highway on the Canadian side also has similar weather, but is mostly paved and has no outer lines, unlike the American side, which is only paved west of Chicken, and does have outer lines.
text_zh: 5號公路，從育空邊境到特特林路口，可以透過**多霧、多雨**的天氣和第二代相機來辨識。
注意：加拿大一側的世界之巔公路也具有類似的天氣，但大多是鋪設好的路面，且沒有外側標線；不像美國一側，只有雞鎮以西是鋪設好的路面，而且確實有外側標線。

text: Prudhoe Bay, the northernmost town in America covered by street view, can be recognized by **cold, dead** landscape, overcast clouds and lack of tall buildings. A second Google car can sometimes be seen.
text_zh: 普魯德霍灣 (Prudhoe Bay) 是美國最北端有街景覆蓋的城鎮，可以透過其**寒冷、荒蕪**的景觀、陰沉的天空以及缺乏高樓大廈來辨識。有時可以看到第二輛 Google 車。

text: [Nome](https://goo.gl/maps/efqLHvNVtEK2fGPNA), [Unalakleet](https://goo.gl/maps/1DYUKxvbEs7sR17v5) and [Galena](https://goo.gl/maps/aX2axEUDjqNexfiR6) are three isolated Alaskan towns which are covered only by trekker. The trekker’s **lime green hat** or [black and white beanie](https://goo.gl/maps/V28pqftM9fbJ8Qwo6) can be seen.
NOTE: The trekker’s black and white bandana can only be seen in Nome.
text_zh: [諾姆](https://goo.gl/maps/efqLHvNVtEK2fGPNA)、[烏納拉克利特](https://goo.gl/maps/1DYUKxvbEs7sR17v5) 和 [加利納](https://goo.gl/maps/aX2axEUDjqNexfiR6) 是阿拉斯加三個偏遠城鎮，僅由徒步拍攝 (trekker) 覆蓋。可以看到徒步拍攝者 (trekker) 的**螢光綠帽子**或 [黑白毛帽](https://goo.gl/maps/V28pqftM9fbJ8Qwo6)。
注意：徒步拍攝者 (trekker) 的黑白頭巾只能在諾姆看到。
